title: Detailed diamond
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='table' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#e8fbff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#9fe4ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='crown1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#c5f3ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#66c8ee'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='crown2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#8fe0f6'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#3aa7d4'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='pav1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#7fd6f0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#2b8dbb'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='pav2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#4fb8dc'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#1e6e97'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='pav3' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#a8ecff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#4baed3'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- table facet -->
  <polygon points='31,30 69,30 80,22 20,22' fill='url(#table)'/>
  <!-- crown facets left -->
  <polygon points='20,22 31,30 36,44 14,44' fill='url(#crown1)'/>
  <polygon points='31,30 36,44 50,44 50,30' fill='url(#crown2)'/>
  <!-- crown facets right -->
  <polygon points='80,22 69,30 64,44 86,44' fill='url(#crown1)'/>
  <polygon points='69,30 50,30 50,44 64,44' fill='url(#crown2)'/>
  <!-- girdle line accents -->
  <polygon points='14,44 86,44 84,47 16,47' fill='#bff0ff'/>
  <!-- pavilion facets -->
  <polygon points='16,47 30,47 50,88' fill='url(#pav1)'/>
  <polygon points='30,47 44,47 50,88' fill='url(#pav3)'/>
  <polygon points='44,47 56,47 50,88' fill='url(#pav2)'/>
  <polygon points='56,47 70,47 50,88' fill='url(#pav3)'/>
  <polygon points='70,47 84,47 50,88' fill='url(#pav1)'/>
  <!-- sparkle highlights -->
  <polygon points='36,26 40,32 36,34 32,32' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <polygon points='62,62 64,68 61,70 59,66' fill='#e6fbff'/>
  <polygon points='28,60 30,64 27,66 25,62' fill='#e6fbff'/>
</svg>
